name: Moldova
work_strategy: Remote (Moldova IT Park — preferential 7% single tax for IT residents)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; thereafter CET18: 12% PIT (minus ~127 €/mo personal allowance) + CNAM 54 €/mo = 111–159 €/mo; Unified Tax not credited under DTT.
nature: Weak (Plains, Codri hills, rivers; no sea or mountains — minimal psychological recreation)
english_level: Moderate (Youth speak English; Romanian and Russian widely spoken)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Single entry/exit with any internal document; multiple entries strictly with international passport.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary protection (Protectie temporara) or humanitarian protection.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: EU candidate country, non-EU. Direct EU directive restrictions not yet incorporated, though bilateral border-service cooperation applies.
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: UNHCR aid — 2,200 MDL (~115 €) per person for 2 months. Childbirth grant — 20,000 MDL.
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: Refugee Accommodation Centres (RACs) with free housing for up to 3–9 months. Subsidies for Moldovan host families.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Free emergency medical care. Voluntary insurance costs around 300 MDL per 3 months.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Free evacuation buses from border to Chisinau and Romanian border. City transport at standard fares.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Right to work via simplified procedure under fixed-term contract and protection card.

items: [999.md](https://999.md/ru/category/real-estate) — country's main portal for owner-direct rentals (Chisinau).
[Casahub.md](https://casahub.md/) — modern bank-backed aggregator of verified real estate.

notes: **Strict conditions:** net income `600 / 750 / 800 / 1 000 €/mo` after UA FOP Group 3; no local SP/SRL registration; >1-year horizon with military deferral.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.legality_over_183d_with_deferral: For TP application/renewal in 2026, Moldova requires military status/deferral documents (incl. **Reserve+**) and proof of legal border crossing — with legal deferral, TP is approved (limit: no absences >45 days). **Without TP:** Digital Nomad residence permit requires ~3× average salary (**~52,200 MDL ≈ 2,680 €/mo** — unaffordable).
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.forms_after_183d: Annual individual tax return **CET18** (by April 30). Ukrainian 5% Unified Tax is not credited.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.pit: **12%** flat; personal allowance **29,700 MDL/year** (≈ `127 €/mo` at ~19.5 MDL/EUR) applies if income <360,000 MDL/year (all 600–1,000 € scenarios qualify).
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.cnam_health_insurance: Fixed annual policy **12,636 MDL/year ≈ 54 €/mo** (discounts often available if paid before March). CNAS social fund not mandatory for individuals filing CET18.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.verdict: **Most reliable #1 budget option for >1 year** subject to TP approval: the only country where even **600 €/mo** consistently yields a surplus without threshold jumps.
